summary: Frontend-only test of iteration 3 (economy restructure + reward catalog payouts + persistent notifications + native blocker UI + Mr. Brass mascot). ALL 14 acceptance bullets PASS with 0 console errors / 0 page errors on web preview. Mr. Brass mascot renders as expected on Estudio (top hat in black, brass-coin face in antiqueGold with eyes/mouth/cheeks, suit body, two rubber-hose arms) on the LEFT with a speech bubble welcoming the user (mascotRow). Topic selector card shows 6 topics with difficulty emojis — Matemáticas=🔴, Historia=🟡, Ciencias=🔴, Inglés=🟡, Programación=🔴, Literatura=🟢 — and difficulty line correctly switches from 'Sin tema seleccionado · multiplicador ×1.5 (medio)' to '🔴 Difícil · multiplicador ×2.2 · estimado: +55🪙' after tapping Matemáticas. Integration indicator card renders both '🔔 Notificación persistente activada' and '📵 Bloqueador de apps: requiere build nativo' (isBlockerAvailable=false on web). Casino → Tragamonedas: 'Premios posibles' table maps CEREZA→Común, LIMÓN→Común, CAMPANA→Raro, TRÉBOL→Raro, ESTRELLA→Épico, DIAMANTE→Épico, JACKPOT→Legendario — NO coin payouts listed (consolation note 2🪙 for 2-match is shown as fine-print). Casino → Cajas: 3 boxes show '1% / 5% / 15% chance de legendario' for Bronce/Plata/Oro respectively — exact match. Premios tab has 'Ganados (0)' + 'Catálogo' tabs at top (testID tab-inventario/tab-catalogo); empty inventory shows mascot + 'Inventario vacío' + explanation. Catalog has '+ Nuevo Premio' button (testID add-reward-button) and 7 catalog items r1..r7 each with a pencil edit (testID edit-r1..edit-r7) — confirmed via count. Ajustes shows in order: Audio del casino, Notificaciones (Notificación persistente + Sonido al terminar sesión toggles), Bloqueador de apps (Android) with yellow ⚠️ 'Build nativo requerido' warning, Apps bloqueadas (5 defaults), Apps permitidas (empty whitelist). The +Añadir modal (testID add-blocked) opens with Manual + Package ID inputs. setting-coinsPerMinute field exists in Economía section. requireOptionalNativeModule returns null gracefully — 0 console errors on web preview. NO deprecated expo packages detected (expo-haptics, expo-notifications, expo-router, expo-image, expo-asset, etc. are all current). NO SafeAreaView issues — uses react-native-safe-area-context throughout. App is fully functional on web preview with the documented platform-level caveats (OS notifications and accessibility service only fire in real APK).

issues: SignTitle still truncates on 390px viewport: 'CASINO DE LA SUE...' and 'GALERÍA DE PREM...' and 'AJUSTES DEL CASI...'. Pre-existing from iteration 2 — not blocking but worth shortening titles or making SignTitle responsive.

critical_code_review_comments: casino.tsx is now ~1042 lines — recommend splitting Reel/BoxesSection/BoxCard/BoxOpeningModal/BoxResultModal/SlotResultModal into /src/components/casino/*.tsx (file >700 lines guideline).
premios.tsx is ~667 lines — borderline; consider extracting EditModal and InventoryItem/CatalogItem to /src/components/premios/.
CasinoMascot.tsx is well-structured (no SVG, pure View shapes) and renders cleanly on web — good work.
estudio.tsx uses `void DIFFICULTY_LABEL;` at line 604 as an apparent lint suppression for an unused export — consider just removing the unused import to keep things clean.
All testIDs follow the convention and are present for every interactive element tested. Excellent test coverage scaffolding.
